scope: Complete arithmetic stars and stabilizers for the existing 58 classes; finite edge reduction; sixteen actual invariant scalar harmonic cocycles and bounded boundary measures.

sources.title: Cameron Franc and Marc Masdeu, Computing fundamental domains for the Bruhat-Tits tree for GL2(Qp), p-adic automorphic forms, and the canonical embedding of Shimura curves
sources.use: Definitions of invariant harmonic cocycles and boundary distributions, edge/ball correspondence and finite linear algebra. Our scalar bounded-measure argument is proved directly over the ramified K; no Qp overconvergent control theorem or precision constants are transferred.

sources.title: Marc Masdeu and Eloi Torrents, Fundamental domains for quaternionic S-arithmetic groups over totally real fields
sources.use: Column-lattice tree action over local completions of totally real fields and representatives with global integral entries. No external implementation or full domain algorithm is run.

sources.title: Lassina Dembele, A hyperelliptic Shimura quotient of genus 16
sources.use: Geometric uniformization retained from D110. The paper's hyperellipticity claim is not used; the project's D99 nonhyperelliptic conclusion remains unchanged.

local_sources.use: Read-only same-session ideal and transport data. All local stars and global ideal sandwich assertions are independently certified.
The unchanged 58-class matrix, full stabilizer counts and class-number facts. Complete class/unit enumeration retains its certified Magma provenance.
Fixed exact Hensel splitting, refined on the same root branch when reduction needs more precision.
Arithmetic group identification, explicit u/W/h witnesses and 643 inherited source hashes.

project_deductions: P-supported exact global indices plus residue-spanning local frames certify all 58 global right ideals by localization and Nakayama.
All 174 neighbor transports and 164 projective stabilizer elements give complete three-element local stars, exact reversals and a terminating arithmetic edge reducer.
A 376-by-174 integer relation matrix has rank 158; sixteen integral null vectors are independent, certified by exact products and ranks modulo 101.
There are 155 oriented edge orbits, nine inverted orbits and 73 reversal pairs; scalar harmonic values vanish on the inverted orbits.
The chosen cocycle basis has integer values of absolute size at most four, giving uniform measure denominator bound d=0 on all boundary compact opens.
Exact Newton refinement and Hensel branch checks support reduction beyond the initial splitting precision; the reduced-precision control recovers the same depth-32 answer.
excluded_inferences: No separate connected fundamental subtree, group presentation or complete generating set.
No saturated integral cohomology basis claim.
No actual moment bank, dyadic CM/frame matching, Shimura tangent/jet or candidate identification.
No target polynomial, expanded class census, new level or Hecke prime.
No unchanged transfer of a Qp overconvergent control theorem to K.
